text:
By Country Herald Police Reports ,
4 hours ago Country Herald is Local News, Independent Pulse. Covering breaking local news, sports, lifestyle and events. Indianapolis, IN – Fire crews responded to a second-floor apartment fire Wednesday afternoon at 7543 Kingsport Rd, inside the Lake Castleton Apartments, according to the Indianapolis Fire Department (IFD). The call came in around 4:34 p.m., when firefighters arrived to find flames showing from a rear window on the second floor.
